page.layout: One printed page on the scan (right page, main text, with a narrow strip of the facing left page at the far left edge showing fragments of margin text, which is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed). Main text in one column. Two-column diagram-like brace structure in the middle (Horum autem supellex / Externa / Interna, and Exter-na erat / Tegmentum / Tabulatum) with references to the right of braces, as lines of the text.

main_text.p: Hi figurabat ἀρχιτέκτονας ecclesiæ, prophetas, & Apostolos Christi. 1. Cor. 3. 10. Eph. 3. 20. nominatim ab vtere separatos & vocatos. Ierc. 1. 5. Gal. 1. 15.

p.i: Atq; hæc de causis, quarum præcipuè efficientes alijs rebus sacris sunt communes:

main_text.p: Sanctuarij partes ita compositæ erant, vt facilè & disiungi, & coniungi poterant. Exod. 26. 15. 30. & Num. 3. 36. & 7. 8.

Significabat autem, fideles in hoc tabernaculo suo corporis (quod & deponendum & irrigendum est) peregre abesse à domino, donec ad regnum stabile venissent in cœlis. Deut. 12. 9. 2. Cor. 6. 4. 2. Pet. 1. 13. inter se comparatis.
Partes hæ sunt sanctuarij siue totius tabernaculi membra: Sunt autem inter se varia tabernacula & loca sancta, & proinde species. Exod. 26. 9. cum Exo. 40. 17. 33. Heb. 9. 2.
Horum autem supellex varia erat: Externa. Exod. 25. 9. 10. Interna. 17. 22. 33. & 26. 1. 7. 8. 35. 36.
Tegmentum erat externum, ad interna tegenda & protegenda.
Significat, totam ecclesiam eiusq; membra, sub Dei veluti tegumento & protectioni semper sedere. Esa. 4. 4. Psal. 27. 5.
Tabulatum, erat ex asseribus siue columnis

page.notes: Diagram braces (Externa/Interna, Tegmentum/Tabulatum) rendered as running text; the marginal reference numbers are printed beside the braces. The catchword-like "T4 tota" at the foot is a signature/catchword and is uncertain. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are omitted. Several words in the Greek and in the italic passage are uncertain.
